title: A single genotype example links the PCA calculations

title: A four-SNP likelihood for an ancestry proportion
caption: Known reference allele frequencies and four genotypes; independent SNPs and Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium assumed.

caption: The same 30 synthetic genomes are fitted against three reference profiles (top) or two (bottom).

title: Local ancestry labels sum to global ancestry
caption: A deterministic chromosome schematic; lengths, not the number of inferred tracts, determine global ancestry.

title: Population structure can produce a spurious SNP association
caption: Original schematic for the running simulation. The tested SNP has zero direct effect; a separate causal SNP affects the phenotype.

title: A null SNP appears associated in the pooled sample
caption: 600 synthetic individuals; horizontal jitter is for display only. The true tested-SNP effect is zero.

caption: PCA uses 3,000 background SNPs; both tested SNPs are excluded. All 600 individuals are shown.

title: After PC adjustment, compare residual with residual
caption: Both dosage and phenotype are residualized on an intercept and PC1, using the same 600 individuals.

title: Compare estimates with the effects used to generate the data
caption: A single simulation: estimates and 95% t intervals before and after PC1 adjustment; vertical lines show the true effects.

title: How many PCs? Inspect sensitivity of the effect estimate
caption: Null-SNP point estimates and 95% t intervals. Stability in this example does not determine K for another study.

title: A large LD region can dominate the first PC
caption: Synthetic correlated block at SNPs 1,201–1,700; big_randomSVD before filtering, snp_autoSVD after filtering.

title: Inspect SNP loadings before interpreting a PC
caption: All 3,000 PC1 loadings from the unfiltered synthetic example; the highlighted region was deliberately made correlated.

title: The same PCs can track ancestry and technical batch
caption: Identical coordinates in both panels; only the coloring changes. Batch was assigned independently of ancestry.

title: Fit the axes once, then project held-out individuals
caption: snp_autoSVD fits 480 reference individuals; snp_projectSelfPCA supplies OADP scores for 120 held-out individuals.

title: Genomic control rescales the same association statistics
caption: 100,000 synthetic null statistics. The corrected median equals the null median by construction; the same ranks are plotted.

title: Similar Q–Q inflation can have different causes
caption: 100,000 matched normal draws under two LDSC working-model scenarios; both have expected mean χ² = 1.4.

title: LD-score relationships separate these model scenarios
caption: The same statistics as Figure 16. Points are means in 20 bins; lines show generating means, not a fitted real GWAS.

title: LD score sums squared correlations with neighboring SNPs
caption: Exact illustrative population LD. SNP 4: score 3.35, including self-LD 1; four other SNPs exceed the example cutoff 0.20.

title: Relatives create correlated observations
caption: An expected additive relationship matrix for two unrelated, non-inbred parents and two full siblings; realized genomic values vary.

title: Parental transmission and family environment are different pathways
caption: Original teaching DAG. Conditioning on parental genotypes uses within-family segregation; causal interpretation still requires assumptions.

title: Local ancestry supplies information beyond a global proportion
caption: Original two-copy schematic for an ancestry-specific association model; it is not output from Tractor-Mix or observed genotype data.
